title: galium peregrinum
intro: Galium peregrinum, commonly known as Lady's Bedstraw, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its calming and sedative effects. The health benefits of Galium peregrinum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are primarily attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable remedy for promoting relaxation and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress.
